open MeasureTheory

variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
  [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] [SecondCountableTopology E]
  [StandardBorelSpace E] [Nonempty E]
definition_context: Measure E is a nonnegative extended-real measure on E. IsProbabilityMeasure μ means its total mass is one. StandardBorelSpace is the standard Borel measurable-space condition; Nonempty provides an inhabitant but adds no geometric dimension restriction.

WassersteinSpace.wassersteinDistance μ ν is the real-power square root of the infimum of ∫‖x−y‖² dγ over couplings γ. A coupling means the coordinate pushforwards equal μ and ν. Empty infima and nonintegrable costs are interpreted in the nonnegative extended reals.

ℝ≥0∞ includes infinity. All comparisons and addition displayed in the statement use this extended order and arithmetic. NormedAddCommGroup supplies a norm and additive commutative group, not a scalar/vector-space structure. BorelSpace identifies the measurable structure with the Borel σ-algebra of that topology.
cases.statement:
example
    (μ₁ μ₂ μ₃ : Measure E)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure μ₁] [IsProbabilityMeasure μ₂] [IsProbabilityMeasure μ₃]
    {r₁₂ r₂₃ : ℝ≥0∞}
    (hr₁₂ : WassersteinSpace.wassersteinDistance μ₁ μ₂ < r₁₂)
    (hr₂₃ : WassersteinSpace.wassersteinDistance μ₂ μ₃ < r₂₃) :
    WassersteinSpace.wassersteinDistance μ₁ μ₃ < r₁₂ + r₂₃
